meta.criticalContext: As of the 18 Aug 2026 audit, NO core page on fillobakes.com renders a <title> tag. No meta descriptions, no canonicals, no OG tags, no favicon, no JSON-LD. Only /shokupan has a title, and it is missing from sitemap.xml. This file is the fix. Every route below must ship with its title, description, canonical, OG image and JSON-LD server-rendered.
titleRules: Under 60 characters where possible. Brand suffix ' | Fillo Bakes' only where it fits.
Lead with the noun a person would type, not with the brand.
'Bangalore' in the title beats 'Bengaluru' for search volume; use 'Bengaluru' in body copy and 'Bangalore' in titles and keywords. Both appear on the page so both are indexed.
No emoji. No exclamation marks. Sentence case except proper nouns.
descriptionRules: 140-160 characters. One fact, one differentiator, one action.
Never promise a delivery time the van cannot keep.

routes.metaDescription: Authentic Japanese shokupan, baked eggless in Bengaluru. Cloud-soft crumb, subtle sweetness, no preservatives. Delivered fresh or from the van.
routes.decision: KEEP THIS URL LIVE. It is currently the only page on the site with a title tag and it is documented as ranking. Do NOT 301 it into the journal. Instead: keep /shokupan as a commercial landing page that sells the loaf, add it to sitemap.xml (it is currently missing), and link it to /journal/what-is-shokupan as the editorial companion. Two pages, two intents, cross-linked, no cannibalisation. This supersedes the /shokupan redirect suggested in products.json.

sitemapNotes: The current sitemap lists 12 /product/* URLs, of which 8 render 'Product Not Found' at HTTP 200. Remove all 12 and replace with the 23 real /shop/[slug] URLs.
/fillo-plus, /franchise, /blogpage and /shokupan are all absent from the current sitemap. The new sitemap must include every route in this file except those marked noindex.
Add lastmod per URL, driven by the CMS, not a build-time constant.
Every dead legacy URL gets a 301 from the redirects array in products.json.
openIssuesBlockingSeo: No title tags site-wide. This is the single highest-impact fix in the entire rebuild and costs nothing.
No OG image. The default crumb shot does not exist and must be photographed.
FSSAI licence number unknown, so LocalBusiness markup is incomplete.

No street address exists — it is a van. Bakery markup must use areaServed and a GeoCircle rather than a fake storefront address. Publishing a fake address to satisfy schema would be worse than an incomplete entity.
No real per-product reviews exist. Do not emit AggregateRating until they do.
Two different contact emails are published across the site, which breaks NAP consistency for local search.
Route names and run days do not exist as content. /van/[route] and /areas/[area] are the two highest-value new SEO surfaces and neither can ship until the founders supply them.
The delivery fee (₹49) and free-delivery threshold (₹499) are marked [TBC] in DECISIONS.md. They appear in area-page meta descriptions, so those metas are provisional.
